data.summary: The analysis matches Tesla's reported fiscal 2025 results (checked from memory, without source documents). Revenue ($94.8B vs $97.7B, down 2.9%), gross profit ($17.1B, 18.0% margin), operating income ($4.4B vs $7.1B, 4.6% margin), R&D ($6.4B vs $4.5B), net income ($3.8B vs $7.1B, down 46.5%) and diluted EPS ($1.08 vs $2.04) are all consistent. R&D being the main driver of the operating income drop holds up: higher R&D accounts for about $1.9B of the roughly $2.7B decline.
